pose_convention.tcp_pose: [x, y, z, rx, ry, rz] in robot base frame
pose_convention.orientation: rotation vector (axis multiplied by angle in radians)
pose_convention.T_base_tcp: 4x4 homogeneous matrix mapping TCP coordinates to robot base
pose_convention.tool_frame: TCP configured on the robot at collection time

synchronization: Sequential camera/RTDE reads, not hardware synchronized. Keep robot stationary for capture.
